question: Which Union Minister of India launched the Transport 4 All Challenge Stage-2 in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Hardeep Singh Puri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The correct answer is option 2, Hardeep Singh Puri.**
 
• Hardeep Singh Puri is the **Union Minister of State (Independent Charge) in the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs and the Ministry of Civil Aviation.**
 
• The Transport 4 All Challenge Stage-2 is an initiative under the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs that** aims to promote innovation in the field of urban transportation.**
 
• The first stage of the challenge was launched in 2019 and received a good response from participants across the country.
 
• The challenge invites startups, students, and individuals to develop innovative solutions to improve urban transportation and provide accessible and affordable transport options to all.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Dharmendra Pradhan is the Union Minister of Education and Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
 
• Sarbananda Sonowal is the Union Minister of Ports and Shipping Waterways.
 
• Raj Kumar Singh is the Union Minister of Power and New and Renewable Energy.
